comparator: Four diagnostic cells with two-word names and one matching-format demonstration; not a single-factor causal comparison
budget: 32 tasks x 2 samples; fixed 128-token requested horizon with native block rounding; total allocated positions <=512
stopping_rule: All fixed tasks and repeats; no performance-dependent resampling
invalidation_conditions: Wrong reference answers, recoverable purported bad branch, context overflow, missing samples, or changed decoding invalidate the affected cell
